CustomObject.description: Published by AIAgentTurnTrace as AIAgentManager starts each phase of a turn (a data source read, a provider callout), so the chat LWC's "Working on it" card can show live progress. Published Immediately, not after commit - the enclosing AiMessageProcessingQueueable transaction is still running mid-callout when these are meant to arrive, so there is no "commit" to wait for. Best-effort only: a dropped or delayed event never affects the turn itself, only what the working indicator shows meanwhile.
CustomObject.label: AI Agent Progress Event
